what: The t-bone-12 calibration row (scenarios/damage/t-bone-12.json) as a jj-fixture scenario, so `jj sim --trace scenarios/damage/fixtures/t-bone-12.json` shows the damage introspection (P1-S04a): each part's health and state in every car observation, and in the trace the contact episodes (car, part, other body, its causal owner, summed impulse, closing speed) and the part-loose and part-detached transitions with their cause and instigator, at their ticks.
